claims.statement: Tom Allen and his trainer Ned Donnelly put on the gloves and sparred at an entertainment on February 22, 1876.
claims.excerpt: the champion and young Donnelly put on ihe gloves

claims.statement: Tom Allen's Gymnasium club held an entertainment in honour of Ned Donnelly.
claims.excerpt: under the auspices of Tom Allen’s Gymnasium club last night

claims.statement: Ned Donnelly had trained Tom Allen for the Rooke fight, which did not come off.
claims.excerpt: the Rook fight, which dtl not come off

fights.excerpt: the Rook fight, which dtl not come off
fights.notes: Mentioned only in passing; the fight did not take place.

notes: Sparring at a club entertainment, not a contest.
